question: The Appalachians mountain region is a part of which continent?
solution:
The correct answer is __**North America.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Appalachians, located in the Central and Southern regions**, It is one of the most biodiverse locations in **North America **
 
• the Appalachian Mountains, which are also known as the Appalachians, a great highland system of **North America, and the eastern part of the Rocky Mountains.**
 
• The Region's 26 million live in parts of **Alabama, Georgia, Kentucky, Maryland, Mississippi, New York, North Carolina, Ohio, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Tennessee, and Virginia, and all of West Virginia.**
 
• Most of the parts of the Appalachian region are mountainous and rocky while others do have flat fertile lands. Many other of crops are grown in this region including fruits, berries, grain, and potatoes. They are grown mostly in the Annapolis Valley.
 
• The Appalachian Mountains formed from terrane accretion and the collision of Gondwanaland with ancient North America as the Iapetus Ocean close

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• ** Mountain Peak - Country**.

 
 
• Atna Peaks - Alaska.
 
• Avalanche Peak - Yukon.
 
• Bald Mountain - Colarado.
 
• Denali - Alaska.
 
• Mount Darwin - California.
 
• Mount Dubois - California.
